headline: UK government plans £100m AI biosecurity lab
standfirst: The chancellor is set to announce a new facility focused on AI risks in the upcoming

steps.label: What happened
steps.text: The UK government is investing £100 million into a new, world-first AI biosecurity lab.

steps.label: How we got here
steps.text: This funding is being unveiled as part of the chancellor's upcoming Budget announcement.

steps.label: Why it matters
steps.text: The goal is to strengthen the UK's national defences against potential threats from AI.

steps.label: What to watch
steps.text: Look for further details on the lab's specific operations during Wednesday's Budget speech.

caption:
The UK government is investing one hundred million pounds into a new AI biosecurity lab.

This facility is designed to address security concerns linked to artificial intelligence. It marks a significant financial commitment to national safety ahead of the Budget announcement.
